stem:
Based on following statements choose the correct option:
Statement - I : Theory of Plate tectonics was given by H.H. Hess in 1967.
Statement - II : Theory of Plate Tectonics is based on Theory of Seafloor Spreading.

options.label: a
options.text: Statement - I and Statement - II both are true

options.label: b
options.text: Statement - I and Statement- II both are false

options.label: c
options.text: Statement - I is true but Statement - II is false

options.label: d
options.text: Statement - I is false but Statement - II is true

expl: The concept of plate tectonics was formulated in the 1960s. Wilson, Morgan, Parker, McKenzie, Harry Hess etc. contributed to the development of this theory. The theory of plate tectonics is based on the ocean floor spreading theory.

stem: From which of the following coasts the mean sea level of India is measured ?
expl: The mean sea level of India is measured with reference to the Chennai coast.

stem: The limit of the territorial water of India extends up to:
expl: Territorial waters in the area of the sea immediately adjacent to the shore of a state are subject to the territorial jurisdiction of that state. This area is generally 12 nautical miles.

options.label: d

expl: In ancient Indian historical geography the Indian Ocean has been named as “Ratnakara”- a place where gems and jewels are found.

stem: Maximum Coastal erosion is caused by :
expl: Sea waves, tides, currents, tsunami waves and human activities etc. have a major role in coastal erosion. Most of these coastal erosions are caused by waves.
